confirm.title: Let the assistant do this?
confirm.message: The assistant wants to run an action that changes something beyond this conversation. It runs only if you say so.

panel.keyHint: Paste an OpenRouter API key. It stays in this browser and is sent to OpenRouter and nowhere else. Free models take about fifty requests a day per key.
panel.empty: Say what should happen. For example: open the ticket about the blank invoice PDF, assign it to Dana and reply that the fix ships on Monday.
panel.keyProblem: That does not look like an OpenRouter key. It starts with sk-or- and is pasted on its own, without Bearer or quotes.

error.noKey: No OpenRouter key is set. Paste one in the panel first.
error.timeout: OpenRouter did not answer within {{seconds}} seconds. Free models are shared; try again.
error.modelGone: Free models come and go. Put another slug in MODEL in assistant-agent.ts; the free ones that can call tools are listed at {{models}}.
